kreate.description: Kreate is a multilingual YouTube Music frontend for Android, built for speed and customization. 🎵 Play music online or offline with caching and downloads 🎨 Switch between RiMusic and ViMusic styles, customize themes, and enjoy audio visualizers 📊 Track listening stats, manage playlists, and share with friends 📺 Works with Android Auto, Android TV, and supports YouTube videos ⚙️ Includes lyrics editing/translation, sleep timer, widgets, and auto‑update.
